title: Lesson 1.0: Mastery Starter

scenes.vo: Lesson one point zero. Mastery Starter.

scenes.sub: Most crypto losses aren't market losses; they're mistakes and scams: a seed phrase typed into a fake site, an approval signed without reading, the wrong network. This module builds the habits that prevent them.

scenes.title: Words you'll need
scenes.vo: Private key, the secret that signs transactions. Approval, permission for an app to move a token. Multisig, a wallet that needs several keys to act. Phishing, a fake site or message built to steal. Simulation, a preview of what a transaction will change.

scenes.title: The mastery ladder
scenes.vo: Beginner, Uses a separate burner wallet and reads every prompt. Practitioner, Runs the before-signing checklist without notes; limited approvals; hardware wallet. Master, Multisig vault, simulation on every signature, private addresses, tested recovery.
